relationships.subject: peripheral nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: The analysis of adiponectin and PPARγ revealed that adiponectin was upregulated after nerve damage only in males with a parallel increase of PPARγ expression.

relationships.subject: peripheral nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: peripheral nerve injury at D7 induced a decrease of EE and REE in both sexes

key_findings: Nerve injury drives sex-specific adipose tissue responses: females show steroid/lipid oxidation and higher energy expenditure, males show adiponectin and PPAR-gamma upregulation.
